title: The Starry Night: AquaTerra's Christmas carnival · AquaTerra
description: The Starry Night, AquaTerra's Christmas carnival in Kolkata: kids' carnival days at Pather Sathi and the winter fundraiser at Sky Turf, {years}.
lede: The Starry Night is AquaTerra's Christmas carnival: games, music and treats for children at Pather Sathi, and a winter fundraising night at Sky Turf that its own listing calls the flagship. Across {years} the carnival has been {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, and every dated day fell in the days around Christmas, between 21 and 26 December.

sections.heading: the kids' carnival at pather sathi
body: The first carnival day in this series was Merry Miracles, Day 4 of the programme at Sunday School, at Pather Sathi on 23 December 2023. It had games, music and festive cheer for kids. The next year the carnival came back there as the Christmas Carnival Workshop on 21 December 2024, with games, music, crafts and treats.
Both children's days were run by small teams. The children's carnival is the smaller of the two kinds of event on this page, and it is the part that stays closest to the children it is for.

sections.heading: the night at sky turf
body: The Starry Night fundraiser at Sky Turf on 22 December 2024 was an evening of music, food and cheer, held to raise funds and awareness for AquaTerra's ongoing welfare work. It was the largest team in the carnival series.
Starry Night '25 followed at the same venue on 26 December 2025. Its listing calls it AquaTerra's flagship winter fundraiser, an annual night that brought hundreds together for music and giving back.

sections.heading: one carnival, two forms
body: In December 2024 the carnival ran in both forms within a week. A Christmas Carnival Workshop for children at Pather Sathi came on 21 December, and The Starry Night fundraiser at Sky Turf followed on 22 December. The same idea of music and cheer sat behind both, one for kids and one as a night out that raised funds for the welfare work.

That pairing is the clearest picture of the carnival: a day for children, and a night that pays for the work. The other nights are gathered in [every night that paid for the work](/impact/the-nights-that-fund-the-work).

sections.heading: where the carnival goes back
body: Two places come back. Pather Sathi hosted the carnival in December 2023 and again in December 2024, and Sky Turf hosted the fundraiser in December 2024 and December 2025. Both are places we keep going back to.
A venue that works is worth keeping, and the carnival's shape has stayed the same: games and music for children, and music and food at the night.

sections.heading: help with the next one
body: Students can [join AquaTerra](/join) and volunteer on the next carnival or winter night. For the other festive days we have run, see [festival drives](/impact/festival-drives), which covers the Diwali and Christmas days in one place.

learnings: One carnival idea can serve two audiences: a children's workshop at Pather Sathi and a fundraising night at Sky Turf both ran in December 2024.
Keep the venue that works: Pather Sathi hosted the carnival in 2023 and 2024, and Sky Turf hosted the fundraiser in 2024 and 2025.
The carnival is a late-December event: every dated day fell between 21 and 26 December.
Say what the night pays for: the 2024 fundraiser named the welfare work it raises funds for.

faqs.a: The Starry Night is AquaTerra's Christmas carnival. It has two parts: children's carnival days with games, music, crafts and treats at Pather Sathi, and a winter fundraising night at Sky Turf in Kolkata with music and food.

faqs.q: Where is The Starry Night held?
faqs.a: The children's Christmas carnival was held at Pather Sathi in December 2023 and December 2024. The fundraising night was held at Sky Turf in Kolkata in December 2024 and December 2025.

faqs.q: When is The Starry Night held?
faqs.a: The Starry Night is held in the days around Christmas. Every dated carnival day on this page fell between 21 and 26 December, across {years}.

faqs.q: Does The Starry Night raise money for AquaTerra's welfare work?
faqs.a: Yes. The 2024 fundraising night was held to raise funds and awareness for AquaTerra's ongoing welfare work. AquaTerra is self-funded and takes no donations, so events like The Starry Night help pay for that work.

faqs.q: How can I volunteer at a Christmas carnival?
faqs.a: Join AquaTerra as a student and sign up for the next carnival or winter night. The children's carnival days were run by volunteers with games, music, crafts and treats.
